verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's own NIW pages describe a flat attorney fee for the I-140 and publish a concrete payment figure ($500/month over 14 months, or a 10% discount for paying in full). That lets a founder infer a real price for NIW without a consultation, and RFE responses are included at no extra cost. However, no explicit flat-fee dollar amount or priced menu appears for its other services (H-1B, O-1, PERM, compliance), and government and Adjustment of Status fees are handled separately. Missing for 10: an explicit stated flat-fee total for NIW, published prices for other visa and employer services, a consolidated priced service menu, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see real prices before I talk to anyone — published flat fees or a priced service menu on the provider's own site

citations.quote: pay in full (10% discount available) or spread over 14 months at $500/month
